name: List All Occupancies Documents
description: Returns all occupancy's documents that meet the filter criteria

queryFilters.name: filters[OccupancyId]
queryFilters.description: Filter by occupancy identifier. All GET requests must include a filter for [OccupancyId] or [LastUpdatedAtFrom].

queryFilters.name: filters[LastUpdatedAtFrom]
queryFilters.description: Filter occupancy documents updated at or after this date-time. All GET requests must include a filter for [OccupancyId] or [LastUpdatedAtFrom].

queryFilters.name: page[number]
queryFilters.description: Page number for pagination. Default is 1.

queryFilters.name: page[size]
queryFilters.description: Number of results per page. Default is 50.

responseFields.name: data[].LastUpdatedAt
responseFields.description: The date the occupancy's details were last updated

responseFields.name: data[].OccupancyDocuments
responseFields.description: Array containing a list of documents associated with an occupancy. An occupancy document is classified as either a lease or a supporting document

responseFields.name: next_page_path
responseFields.description: The URL path to the next page of responses
